component.name: Ember
component.summary: Temperature monitor with an always-on-top overlay

description.p: Ember shows your CPU, GPU, RAM and drive temperatures in a small, good-looking overlay that stays on top of your desktop and borderless games, plus a full dashboard with live graphs.

ul.li: Pill, card or ring overlay styles, click-through, drag it anywhere
Usage and power draw for CPU and GPU
Colour-coded warnings and desktop notifications when something runs hot
Every sensor your hardware exposes, with session minimum and maximum
